# Menu 242 (camera scale and add) on every camera key of camera3.pmm. The
# 16 values are the dialog's (scale, add) pairs in edit-id order 686..701:
# eye x, y, z, target x, y, z (add in degrees), distance, fov.
load pmm camera3.pmm
select camera
select all camera
multiply camera 2 1 1 0 0.5 -2 1 10 1 0 1 -5 0.5 0 1 5
save pmm multiplied.pmm
select all camera
save vmd multiplied.vmd
